name: KB-DPP core

name: KB-DPP implementation
what_it_is: Implementation guide for the contract: record contract, identity, format, digest, vectors and validation scenarios

name: OKF conventions
what_it_is: Header conventions (id, type, title, description, sources, generated, verified, stale_after) that the KBOL profile adopts as inspiration, without declaring full external compatibility

what_it_is: Locator profile by lines of a text

name: pdf-v1
what_it_is: Locator profile by physical page and normalized region of a PDF

name: norm-v1

name: structure-v1
what_it_is: Profile of the structured representation of a legal norm against which `kbol citations` resolves citations
origin: Defined by KBOL; produced by tools/di

name: Docling
what_it_is: Document processor pinned to an exact version in the tools of the Document Intelligence pilot
